bonuses.name: Living Metal
bonuses.text: At the start of each of this Threat’s turns it regains 1 Wound and 1 Shock.

abilities.name: Kill Frenzy
abilities.text: When a Lokhust Destroyer rolls a complication, they become utterly obsessed with destroying one random enemy they can see. It will focus all efforts on chasing and attacking that target.

abilities.name: Reanimation Protocols
abilities.text: When a Lokhust Destroyer is killed but not destroyed outright, spend 1 Ruin to return them to life with 1 Wound

options.name: Heavy
options.text: If a Mob of Lokhust Destroyers enters play with 5 or more members, one of them will be equipped with a Gauss Destructor:

mobAbilities.name: Repulsor Slipstream
mobAbilities.text: Mobs of Lokhust Destroyers add +1 to their Movement rate
